comments.author: judyjoseph
comments.body:
Initial update: 

Oct 20 00:02:45.922548 arc-switch1025 ERR pmon#xcvrd[34]: :- initializeGlobalConfig: Sonic database config global file doesn't exist at /var/run/redis/sonic-db/database_global.json

>>>> This file database_global.json is not created in single ASIC platforms, hence this error message should not affect.
          Multi-asic platforms don’t have this error message. Will check how to suppress this error message in swsscommon.

Oct 20 00:03:42.371442 arc-switch1025 ERR pmon#xcvrd[34]: :- initializeGlobalConfig: SonicDBConfig Global config is already initialized

>>>  It is because the API initializeGlobalConfig() is called from the parent xcvrd process and its child threads. It is an INFO message and not an ERR, as it just tells the global config is initialized already. Will take care of it in xcvrd itself.

linkedPullRequests.title: [xcvrd] Remove log errors in single ASIC platforms with init Global config
linkedPullRequests.author: judyjoseph
linkedPullRequests.body:
Add check to make sure that the initializeGlobalConfig is invoked only in multi-asic platforms.

Additionaly remove the initializeGlobalConfig() call in the DomUpdate thread and SFPUpdate process. This is because initializeGlobalConfig() is already invoked and initialized in the parent Xcvrd daemon which is available to the child thread/process.

This fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5680
